The German Research Foundation (DFG) has accepted Privatdozent Wanja Wiese from the University of Bonn to its Heisenberg Programme. This provides five years’ worth of funding that enables researchers to complete high-quality projects and thus further enhance their academic and scientific reputation. A philosopher and mathematician, Wiese studies the possibility of consciousness in artificial systems and now stands to receive funding of up to €570,000.

The University of Bonn works closely with University Hospital Bonn on the Venusberg and a range of non-university research organizations, non-research academic institutions maintained by government and administrative organizations as well as a range of foundations and other organizations. The Faculty of Agriculture at the University of Bonn also maintains a number of teaching and research units in the environs of Bonn.
University of Bonn's Partnership with Welo
The University of Bonn also partners with Karos (formerly goFLUX), a company that supports carpooling. Staff and students can use this service. For more information, see the FAQ.

The University of Bonn has joined forces with a consortium of 200 employers including Deutsche Telekom, Deutsche Post DHL Group and the University Hospital Bonn, in the “moveBonn” scheme, in an attempt to reduce traffic in the Greater Bonn Area, especially during the morning and evening rush hours. The scheme seeks to encourage the use of alternatives to single-person car transport.

Die »Toolbox Digitale Barrierefreiheit« ist eine umfassende Ressource der ILIAS-Community. Sie bietet wichtige Informationen zur Förderung der Barrierefreiheit, darunter Lerneinheiten zu Grundlagen und zu Situation von Studierenden mit Beeinträchtigungen. Zudem werden gesetzliche Verpflichtungen erklärt und assistive Technologien vorgestellt.
